environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate (platform version 1.4.0) behind an ALB. The task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem with tmpfs mounted at /var/app/reports. The container runs with a custom seccomp profile loaded via ECS task definition parameter 'seccompProfile' that denies the 'execve' and 'execveat' syscalls (applied via the container-level linuxParameters). Additionally, the ECS task role has no IAM permissions beyond ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and logs:PutLogEvents. The ALB has an associated WAF WebACL with rule group 'CommonRuleSet' in COUNT mode only (not block).

config.waf: WebACL with AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet in COUNT mode
config.network: awsvpc, security group allows inbound 8080 from ALB SG only
